concerns.text: Task T027 ('policy rigidity' calculation) depends on the output of T027b ('run_entropy_regression'). However, T027b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) and appears after T027 in the list. If T027b runs in parallel with T027, T027 will fail to find the required `entropy_regression.json` file. T027b must precede T027, and T027 cannot be parallel-safe relative to T027b.

Task T030 (cost-benefit ratio) explicitly requires loading the 'held-out validation set' generated by T023b. T023b is listed after T023 but before T030, yet T030 is not marked as dependent on T023b. If T030 runs before T023b completes (or if T023b is skipped/parallelized incorrectly), the validation set will be missing. T030 must strictly follow T023b.

Task T021 (logging in runner) depends on the router logic implemented in T017. While T017 is listed before T021, T021 is marked [P] (parallel-safe). If T021 runs in parallel with T017, it will attempt to import or call `OPIDRouter` before it is fully implemented. T021 must be ordered after T017 and cannot be parallel-safe relative to it.

Task T023b (data splitting) is placed inside Phase 5 (US3) but logically must occur BEFORE the episode loop (T024) starts to ensure the split configuration is saved and available for the sweep. The current ordering implies it might run after the sweep logic is defined but before execution; however, to be safe, it should be explicitly placed before T024 and T025.
